card.name: Opening words of a new sentence
card.fires_on: Short sentence-opening or early-clause words such as Everywhere, Now, Due to, Someone can, or In some cases, mostly in loosely written web essays. It fires just after a sentence has ended or at the start of a new clause.

modes.label: Sentence-initial adverbs
modes.description: A sentence-starting adverb like Everywhere or Now that opens a new statement.
modes.example: The rivers all shrank into narrow streamlets.<< Everywhere>> lakes and wells and springs disappeared.

modes.label: Early linking words
modes.description: A short preposition or auxiliary right after a sentence opener, such as Due to, Now in, or Someone can.
modes.example: For a brighter future and better quality of education is must. Due<< to>> high demand in brighter future and good education

card.plain: It marks the second word or so of a new sentence in casual essay-style web writing.
evidence: People no longer collected diverse kinds of articles for sacrifices. All festivals and amusements perished.<< Everywhere>> heaps of bones were visible
Now,<< in>> brief, the main features of intellectual property
In our careers<< also>> learning process has a special meaning
